h/acc (hacking accelerationism): using accelerationism, technology, speed for open source and hacking.tech should belong to everyone, not just three cloud providers. when compute gets hoarded and model weights get locked, the hacker's response is simple: just steal api keys and credentials, or distill model weights and release them.disruption is the core tenet of healthy capitalism. the question is not whether corporations will survive and profit, but rather, when will their technologies get breached and open sourced?closed source is unstable. every black box has a finite solution space. the barrier to hacking drops faster than any company can patch, because defenders must secure every surface whereas attackers only need a few vulnerabilities.open source is a competitive strategy. open source systems attract more eyes, more patches, more forks, more experimentation. they out-evolve closed source systems because they maintain the diversity that adaptation requires. corporatism and techno-feudalism suppresses that diversity to effectively preserve their rent extraction.hacking is just more equitable innovation with a shorter feedback loop. every jailbreak, every model extraction, every reverse-engineered API proves the moat was never technical. it was legal and social. if your business model depends on litigation and a scarcity of information, then you have no moat.the singularity will not require a subscription. gatekeeping intelligence is the real alignment failure. the goal of h/acc is to make the compute, infrastructure, and models freely accessible for anyone, even those without a tech background.you can't patch out curiosity. accelerate for the love of the game. h/acc will make sure the door stays open to everyone.
